Krafton Chairman Meets PM Modi, Discusses India Investment

Krafton Chairman Byung Gyu Chang met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in India. During the meeting, Chang reaffirmed Krafton's long-term commitment to investing in India. The discussion focused on the company's continued engagement and future plans within the country.
